
# US Stocks — Historical US Stock Market Dataset

> US Stocks is an open-source project providing historical daily stock market data for US-listed companies, along with Python scripts for retrieving, processing, and visualizing the data. It is intended for financial research, quantitative analysis, data science, and machine learning.

## Project Overview

This repository contains historical daily stock market data collected using Python and yfinance.

The project currently includes data collected for:

- NASDAQ: 1,806 companies
- NYSE: 1,045 companies
- NYSE American (AMEX): 0 companies
- Total: 2,851 companies

These figures represent the companies collected in this project, not the total number of companies listed on each exchange.

## Available Data

The dataset is organized by stock exchange and ticker symbol.

Where available, individual company datasets include:

- Date
- Open
- High
- Low
- Close
- Volume
- Daily_Return

The data is stored in CSV format. Historical price charts are also provided as PNG images where available.

Prices are retrieved using yfinance with automatic adjustment enabled. Therefore, OHLC prices may reflect adjustments for stock splits and dividends.

## Repository Structure

- `nasdaq/`: Historical stock data and visualizations for collected NASDAQ companies.
- `nyse/`: Historical stock data and visualizations for collected NYSE companies.
- `ticker_list/`: Ticker symbol lists used by the project.
- `project.py`: Main project script.
- `retrieve_stock_data.py`: Stock data retrieval script.
- `test.py`: Additional testing and experimentation.

## Important Resources

- [README](https://github.com/eshaanmattoo/us_stocks/blob/main/README.md): Project introduction, dataset information, and usage instructions.
- [Main data retrieval script](https://github.com/eshaanmattoo/us_stocks/blob/main/retrieve_stock_data.py): Python implementation for retrieving stock market data.
- [Project script](https://github.com/eshaanmattoo/us_stocks/blob/main/project.py): Main project implementation.
- [NASDAQ dataset](https://github.com/eshaanmattoo/us_stocks/tree/main/nasdaq): Browse collected NASDAQ stock data.
- [NYSE dataset](https://github.com/eshaanmattoo/us_stocks/tree/main/nyse): Browse collected NYSE stock data.

## Intended Use Cases

This dataset may be useful for:

- Historical stock market analysis
- Financial data visualization
- Quantitative finance research
- Time-series forecasting
- Machine learning and deep learning experiments
- Stock return and volatility analysis
- Financial news and sentiment analysis
- Algorithmic trading research

## Data Limitations

- Data availability depends on the underlying yfinance data source.
- Historical coverage varies by company and IPO date.
- Not every listed company is necessarily included.
- The repository does not guarantee real-time or complete market coverage.
- Historical data should be independently validated before being used in financial research or trading systems.
- This project is intended for educational and research purposes, not financial advice.

## Data Source

Historical stock market data is retrieved through [yfinance](https://github.com/ranaroussi/yfinance), which provides access to Yahoo Finance data.
